companyDescription: Quantum computing platform · Trapped-ion technology leader · Government ($2B Trump grants) + commercial (AWS/Azure/GCP) + cybersecurity/QKD expansion · Only profitable quantum pure-play
priceNote: Pulled back -5.7% on Jun 25 — likely profit-taking. Northland just raised PT to $70 (+27%), Trump signed quantum EO Jun 23. Investor Day Sep 8 is next major re-rate event.
summary: IonQ is the only publicly profitable quantum computing company with $187M TTM revenue (+334.6%) and $308M net income. Trump's executive orders to boost quantum computing (Jun 23) + $2B government grants to 9 quantum firms = direct IONQ tailwind. Investor Day Sep 8 is the next major catalyst. Strong Buy from 13 analysts with $68.79 PT (+36% upside). Revenue expected to double in 2026.

catalysts.name: Trump Quantum Executive Orders
catalysts.description: Trump signed 2 executive orders Jun 23, 2026 to boost US quantum computing and mitigate security threats. $2B in government grants to 9 quantum firms — IONQ among recipients. Government taking equity stakes signals long-term commitment.

catalysts.name: Investor Day
catalysts.description: IonQ Investor Day September 8, 2026. Roadmap to 2M qubits by 2030, 256-qubit chip prototype, modular system upgrades. Northland raised PT to $70 specifically citing this event as re-rate catalyst.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings
catalysts.description: Earnings Aug 5, 2026. Q1 2026 was record: revenue grew 755% YoY, RPOs surged 554% to $470M. Annual guidance raised. Expects revenue to double in full-year 2026.

catalysts.name: Clavis XG Multiplex QKD Launch
catalysts.description: IonQ launched Clavis XG Multiplex Jun 17 — quantum key distribution deployable at scale in metro networks. New revenue stream in quantum cybersecurity.

risks: Valuation: PE 54.88x on $308M net income — high for a company at this scale; any guidance miss = 20%+ de-rate
52-week range $25-84: -40% from ATH $84 already; if Investor Day disappoints, could revisit $35-40
Competition: IBM (1000+ qubits), Google Willow (72 qubits error-corrected), Microsoft fermion approach — all well-funded
Revenue base still small ($187M TTM); 'record' growth is off small base — sustainability of 300%+ growth rates is questionable
High beta (3.18) = most volatile on this list — 5% swings in a day are normal

macroRisk.summary: Fed risk HIGH for IONQ. Beta 3.18 + PE 54x = very sensitive to rate surprises. Wait for early August entry post-FOMC. The Trump EO + Investor Day Sep 8 provide a clear catalyst pathway — just need macro window to open.
